title: Set aside (different measures): Cyberbullying and suicidal thoughts: mixed evidence, or a strong link?
explanation: Claim A states that evidence regarding the link between cyberbullying and suicidality is conflicting, whereas Claim B asserts a clear and strong association between cyberbullying victimization and suicidal ideation.
a_text: Results regarding the association between cyberbullying and self-harm or suicidality are conflicting.
b_text: Suicidal ideation is among the strongest associations with cyberbullying victimization.

supporting_papers.title: Prevalence and Effect of Cyberbullying on Children and Young People

audit.reason: One paper describes the literature as mixed; the other reports a pooled association for a narrower outcome (suicidal ideation). Not opposite findings.
